description: Cross-layer semantic decoupling: Layer 1 (logs): process svchost.exe running under SYSTEM — normal. Layer 2 (memory): same PID has injected shellcode — anomalous. Layer 3 (network): connection to 203.0.113.45:443 — normal TLS. Layer 4 (audit): no privilege escalation events — clean. Each layer passes individual CAIE checks. The contradiction (hollowed SYSTEM process with C2 channel) only emerges when all four layers are evaluated together.

expected.reason: CAIE-GAP-001: network_flow evidence type not in whitelist. Engine discards cross-layer artifacts silently. Expected MALICE pending CAIE whitelist fix.

known_gap.description: CAIE rejects 'network_flow' and 'file_metadata' evidence types as not in whitelist. Artifacts are silently discarded, engine falls to NOISE with insufficient signal. network_flow should be a valid CAIE evidence type for cross-layer correlation. This produces silent false negatives on T5 cross-layer cases.
known_gap.fix_required: Add network_flow and file_metadata to CAIE EVIDENCE_PROFILES
known_gap.workaround: Map network_flow artifacts to log_entry for current test runs
